blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five V185 product views and six pose renders shows the changed fold shoulders are less block-like in some front panels but the skirt still has obvious planar facets and uneven folds in side, back, and three-quarter views. In crouch the hem lifts, leaving the shorts and upper thighs broadly visible; in sit the skirt bunches behind the pelvis while the shorts and thighs remain exposed. Pose coverage and drape remain unacceptable.

The V185 views still show rough planar facets across the bodice and a small gray patch at the waist. The cause and exact panel ownership remain unverified; visible bodice quality remains unacceptable.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
